newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F&N sees full year profit below 1996.
newsitem.headline: F&N sees full year profit below 1996.

text.p: Soft drinks company Fraser & Neave said on Friday it expected its attributable profit for full year ending September 30, 1997 to be less than the previous year.
The company said in a statement that the lower profit would be due to a reduction its development property earnings.
"Income from investment properties is expected to show steady year-on-year growth but...development property earnings will not achieve last year's peak," it said.
"For the full year they continue to be forecast at approximately S$120 million before tax compared to S$236 million a year ago," it added.
For the six months ended March 31, 1997, the group's net profit slipped 18 percent to S$83.54 million.
